# Up&Up Operacional

> Sistema interno da agência Up&Up para centralizar o acompanhamento de clientes, controle de entregáveis, follow-up semanal, termômetro de saúde, planos de ação e dashboard gerencial.

## System Architecture
The system is a monorepo containing a frontend Next.js application and a backend NestJS application.

### Monorepo Structure
- `apps/web`: Frontend built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS.
- `apps/api`: Backend built with NestJS, using Prisma ORM to connect to a PostgreSQL database.
- `docs/`: Product and technical documentation.
- `.agents/`: Agent configuration and tools.

### Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma.
- Database: PostgreSQL 15.
- Authentication: JWT + bcrypt.
- Infrastructure: Docker Compose for local development.

### Core Features
- User Authentication & Role Management.
- Client Tracking & Thermometer (Health Score).
- Deliverables Control.
- Weekly Follow-ups.
- Action Plans.
- Managerial Dashboard.

### Getting Started for AI Agents
- The database schema is located at `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma`.
- Frontend code is primarily inside `apps/web/app` and `apps/web/components`.
- Backend code is primarily inside `apps/api/src` structured into modules (users, auth, clients, alerts, dashboard, followups).
- See `apps/api/README.md` and `apps/web/README.md` for specific app documentation.
